channel.title: Rapid+ Blog
channel.description: Guides on browser privacy, security, speed and how the web works, from the team behind Rapid+ Browser.

item.title: The Binance Hack: What Happened, What Was Lost, and What It Means for You
item.description: Binance says about $6.3 billion was taken, the largest crypto theft on record. Here is what is confirmed, what is only reported, and what nobody knows yet.

item.title: Browser Fingerprinting: How Websites Recognize You Without Cookies
item.description: Nothing is stored on your device, so there is nothing to clear. Here is what fingerprinting measures, how well it works in practice, and what helps.

item.title: Do Ad Blockers Make Pages Load Faster? What the Measurements Show
item.description: Ads and trackers are a big share of what many pages download. What researchers measured, how blocking works, and what it costs.

item.title: Proxy vs VPN: What Each One Actually Hides
item.description: Both put another server between you and the web. They cover different traffic, protect it differently, and hide different things from different people.

item.title: Separate Browser Profiles for Work, Personal and Shopping: Why They Work
item.description: One browser, several separate lives. How profiles keep logins and cookies apart, what they do not protect, and how to set them up well.

item.title: What Is a User Agent String, and Why Do Websites Care?
item.description: Your browser names five other browsers every time it loads a page. The reason is thirty years of browsers pretending to be each other.
